description: An object of this type represents an advance reservation.
An advance reservation reserves (consumable) resources for a certain time period.
Jobs which are submitted into the AR can use these resources.
See also man pages qrsub.1, qrstat.1, and qrdel.1

attributes.name: id
description: A unique identifier for the advance reservation, similar to the job id.

attributes.name: name
description: A name for the advance reservation.

attributes.name: account
description: The account to which the advance reservation is charged.

attributes.name: owner
description: The owner of the advance reservation (the user who submitted the AR).

attributes.name: group
description: The UNIX group of the advance reservation owner.

attributes.name: submission_time
description: The time when the AR was submitted in microseconds since epoch.

attributes.name: start_time
description: The start time of the AR in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: end_time
description: The end time of the AR in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: duration
description: The duration of the AR in microseconds

attributes.name: verify
description: From qrsub -w v|e.

attributes.name: error_handling
description: From qrsub -he yes/no.

attributes.name: state
description: The state of the advance reservation.

attributes.name: checkpoint_name
description: Checkpointing environment jobs running in the AR can use.

attributes.name: resource_list
description: The list of resources requested by the advance reservation (qrsub -l).
Just one hard resource list. @todo The -scope feature is still missing.

attributes.name: resource_utilization
description: The utilization of resources by jobs running in the AR.

attributes.name: queue_list
description: The list of queues requested by the advance reservation (qrsub -q).
Just one hard queue list. @todo The -scope feature is still missing.

attributes.name: granted_slots
description: The queue instances and slot counts the reservation holds (`JG_Type`), the same shape as a job's granted destination identifier list. Set once when the reservation is confirmed.

attributes.name: reserved_hosts
description: Will hold the list of hosts which are reserved for the advance reservation
together with the amount of granted consumables in EH_consumable_resources.
@todo not yet implemented, see CS-430

attributes.name: reserved_queues
description: Holds the list of queues which are reserved for the advance reservation
together with the amount of granted consumables in QU_consumable_resources.

attributes.name: mail_options
description: Mail options for the advance reservation from qrsub -m.

attributes.name: mail_list
description: Mail list for the advance reservation from qrsub -M.

attributes.name: pe
description: The parallel environment which is requested by the advance reservation from qrsub -pe.

attributes.name: pe_range
description: The number of slots (can be a range) which are requested for the advance reservation.

attributes.name: granted_pe
description: The parallel environment which was granted to the advance reservation based on the pe request.

attributes.name: master_queue_list
description: The list of possible master queues requested by the advance reservation (qrsub -masterq).

attributes.name: acl_list
description: The acl_list defines which users may use the advance reservation.

attributes.name: xacl_list
description: The xacl_list defines which users may not use the advance reservation.

attributes.name: type
description: Holds the information from the qrsub -now option (immediate or batch).

attributes.name: qi_errors
description: Number of queue instances which are in some error state.

attributes.name: request_set_list
description: @todo placeholder for implementing the -scope switch
List of request sets. 0 .. 3 request sets can exist: global, master, slave.
Sequential ARs can have a single job request set, the global one.
Parallel ARs can have up to 3 request sets: global requests,
requests for the master task, requests for the slave tasks.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.

attributes.name: granted_resources_list
description: List of granted resources, currently these are granted bindings only.

attributes.name: binding
description: Binding strategy for the advance reservation

attributes.name: project
description: Project the AR was submitted to.

attributes.name: pe_object
description: PE object granted to this AR (PE_Type) when it was scheduled.

attributes.name: allocation_rule
description: The PE allocation rule the advance reservation reserves its slots with (qrsub -par).
It overrides the allocation_rule of the requested PE, in the same way as the -par
switch of qsub overrides it for a job. Only set when the AR requests a PE.
